status: LONDON captured. New York not yet narrated.

decisions.narration: I didn't take any trades in London. I was actually looking for a rebalance since it pushed all day. Once I realised it was just straight going up there was no good entries anyways - no closure through 2 levels at once. Closed through the BB MA multiple times but no other opportunities, since there wasn't much closure through anything else. Was just straight pumping.
decisions.reason: Waiting on a rebalance that never came, in a one-way market that never produced his two-level minimum.

verification.was_it_one_way: YES. Price held above BOTH the 15m and the 1h BB MA for 100% of the London window. The deepest approach to the 15m MA came within 1.09pt and never touched it, so the rebalance he was waiting for genuinely never arrived.
verification.single_level_detail: Almost all of them the candle's own BB MA or VWAP+2 alone - exactly his 'closed through the BB MA multiple times but no other opportunities'.
verification.the_one: 03:03 3m UP, closed through its own MA and the developing VAH. It is a LONG, three minutes into the London open, in the direction he had already dismissed - he wanted a rebalance, i.e. a pullback. The other two (04:48 3m, 04:50 2m, both DOWN) closed through VWAP+1 and the VAH but NOT their own BB MA.
verification.verdict: His recollection is mechanically correct under his own grammar. No qualifying two-level closure in the direction he wanted.

decisions.value: A whole-window pass with a falsifiable mechanical claim attached, and it held. This is the cleanest negative control in the corpus so far.

structural_finding.rule: THE CANDLE'S OWN BB MA IS A MANDATORY LEG OF THE PAIR, not one option among many.
structural_finding.evidence: All 9 takes across the first three narrated days close through the candle's own BB MA (2m or 3m as applicable). The second leg varies freely - VWAP band, developing POC, VAH or VAL - but the own MA is always present.
structural_finding.discriminating_power: On 2026-06-24 London it is the difference between 3 qualifying candles and 1. Without it, two shorts at 04:48/04:50 look like missed entries; with it, they are correctly excluded and his account is exact.
structural_finding.caveat: 9 takes is a small sample and the rule is inferred from them, not stated by him. It should be put to him directly rather than assumed.
structural_finding.implemented: scripts/two_level_check.py, required by default, --any-pair to relax.
